posts.name: Ananya Ananth
posts.cooked:
We have access to the OPPE VM and have solved the NPPEs in it… So, during the exam, we will have access to the NPPE solutions. We will also have access to the man and info pages. So I was wondering if it is okay to store notes in the VM and refer to it during the exam.. Just like a short summary of the man pages the way I typed it down while studying, and also the syntax for some simple loops, conditionals, etc…

I mean, is being able to access our notes like an unintended consequence of getting early access to the VM, or is it meant to be okay?

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
Accessing any kind of notes is not allowed. This is a closed book exam not an open book exam. The exam portal has a cheat sheet which you can access apart from man pages, help & info, other than that nothing else is allowed.

Early access to vm is given so that you can check if vm is working fine, you are able to login, if not then you can join support meet and you can add aliases not to add notes.

Also, vm will get reset before the OPPE so whatever you store will get removed.

posts.name: Ananya Ananth
posts.cooked:
Ahh okay…

21f3000759:

you can add aliases

it was already added in ~/.bashrc … It won’t be removed when the VM resets right?

Also, has the cheat sheet been added to the VM already? Where will it be present?

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
Ananya42:

it was already added in ~/.bashrc … It won’t be removed when the VM resets right?

Yes you have to add it at 6 pm once you get access if its not present

Ananya42:

Also, has the cheat sheet been added to the VM already? Where will it be present?

On the exam portal in your browser.
